row.evidence: Mosaic's pricing page lists "Single Sign-On Authentication" under "Enterprise Only" and its help centre documents SSO with only Google SAML and Microsoft Azure SAML; no SCIM or automated provisioning is documented, and Entra's tutorial says users must be created before SSO.
row.notes: Mosaic (mosaicapp.com, resource planning; Entra gallery name Mosaic Project Operations). Not the FP&A Mosaic (mosaic.tech), which now redirects to HiBob. No SCIM by absence: the pricing page, website sitemap, help-centre sitemap (562 URLs) and integrations list mention no SCIM, user provisioning or IdP directory sync. Plans Starter, Professional and Enterprise have no public prices. SAML SSO (Google or Microsoft Azure) is Enterprise only. Admins can import Members through a CSM-enabled Data Import tool. The security page mentions an "Open API" for data export, but no public API reference was found.

scim.notes: available is false by absence: no SCIM on the pricing comparison, help centre or Entra tutorial; Mosaic never states 'no SCIM'.

user_api.notes: The security page says data can be exported 'through the application or the Open API', but no public API reference was found.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Mosaic Project Operations': SP-initiated SSO only; users must be created in Mosaic before SSO.

google.notes: Mosaic documents Google SAML login; no Google catalogue page checked.

fallbacks.notes: Members can be bulk-imported with the Data Import tool once a CSM enables it; the file format is not stated. Entra's tutorial says users must exist before SSO, so no JIT.
